title:
This type only defines the REST interface to the Kubernetes API Server and provides CRUD operations for
namespaces, services, pods and deployments. For Kubernetes API Server data model, see:
@see https://kubernetes.io/docs/reference/generated/kubernetes-api/v1.22/

For Kubernetes metrics-server API calls (as methods below noted with need of 'metrics-server'), the response
type definitions can be found in the link:
https://github.com/kubernetes/metrics/blob/master/pkg/apis/metrics/types.go
Instruction for deploying metrics-server for Kubernetes:
https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/metrics-server

For Prometheus Operator (v0.53.1) API calls (i.e. Prometheus and ServiceMonitor related methods), the payload and response
definitions can be found here https://github.com/coreos/prometheus-operator/blob/v0.53.1/Documentation/api.md
Install Prometheus Operator with Helm: `helm install prometheus stable/prometheus-operator`

NOTE: Stylistically, all arguments in this file should be either required or explicitly defaulted. This is for
consistency and because the order of arguments is defined by the external API. Therefore, it may not conform
to C3's standard of required arguments first and defaulted arguments after all non-defaulted arguments.
name: K8sApiServer
